questions.question:
Three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if

they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the

statements.

Statements:

All bottles are jugs.

Some bottles are flasks.

All flasks are bins.

Conclusions:

I. Some bottles are bins.

II. Some jugs are bins.

III. Some flasks are jugs.

options.text: All conclusions I, II and III follow
Either conclusion I or II follows
Only conclusions II and III follow
Only conclusions I and II follow

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fd75f8f2cf70c22e3b1d2fe54aa3d34528d0a9abf949f7774b9778cb79c0bf2d.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some bottles are bins → Follow (As some bottles are flasks and all flasks are bins. As bottles has some part common with flasks which whole comes in bins, therefore it is true.)

II. Some jugs are bins → Follow (As all bottles are jugs, some bottles are flasks and all flasks are bins. As whole bottles comes in jugs and has some part common with flasks which whole comes in bins, therefore it is true.)

III. Some flasks are jugs → Follow (As all bottles are jugs and some bottles are flasks. As whole bottles comes in jugs and has some part common with flasks, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, All conclusions I, II and III follow.

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the son of B’,

A − B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

A × B means ‘A is the brother of B’ and

A ÷ B means ‘A is the mother of B’.

Based on the above, if ‘P + Q ÷ R − T × M’, which of the following is true?

options.text: M is the sister of T.
P is the brother of R.
Q is the mother of M.
T is the brother of P.

questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Decoding symbols:

 
 

 
 A is
 
 

 Symbol
 +
 −
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Son
 Wife
 Brother
 Mother
 
 

 
 to B
 
 

Given: P + Q ÷ R − T × M

P + Q → P is the son of Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b843d45519d9073621bc485372eab12dd363ee11268419fdd7fca03f25aa0050.png] 

Q ÷ R → Q is the mother of R.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d61e22a3f19d8c4feb85568edb1bfdceced3b0639e0f5e7689def0dbb774d3a4.png] 

R − T → R is the wife of T.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4629c7a2b12842d6556ed2a341fa3f88ab9232a31268bf63fb702ac04c3cf42.png] 

T × M → T is the brother of M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0b80f8e99073c31e333f21ff2edc92132a0bb14d56e48dd4db3b98590c1ac9e6.png] 

Thus, according to the family tree:

Option 1) M is the sister of T. → Incorrect as M can be either sister or brother of T.

Option 2) P is the brother of R. →** Correct **

Option 3) Q is the mother of M. → Incorrect as Q is the mother-in-law of M's brother

Option 4) T is the brother of P. → Incorrect as T is the brother-in-law of P.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"
